morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语中作为外来姓氏整词使用，通常写作 Majmudar。不把其历史来源中的成分当作现代马来语词缀；具体读音依姓名持有者而定。

senses.zh_definition: 印度姓氏 Majmudar；姓氏词典将其列为 Majumdar 的变体。
senses.en_definition: An Indian surname identified in surname dictionaries as a variant of Majumdar.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga dari India yang merupakan varian nama keluarga Majumdar.
senses.nuances: 这是专有名词，不宜译成现代职业名称。姓氏的历史含义不表示持有者从事该职业，也不能据此推断其国籍、宗教或社会身份。输入未提供具体人物；未确认其为马来语普通词的官方词条，因此不标为 official。下列为自然使用示例，未经高频统计。[姓氏词典：Majmudar](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/majmudar)

etymology.historical_story: The Dictionary of American Family Names identifies Majmudar as a variant of Majumdar. It traces Majumdar to an administrative title meaning record keeper or archivist, combining an Arabic element meaning collection with Persian -dar, possessor. This history concerns the surname, not Malay word formation; a modern bearer need not have any connection with archival work. [Majmudar](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/majmudar), [Majumdar](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/majumdar)
